values.note: Reservable online up to 365 days ahead and for the same day ('Reservations can be made for today'), or at 1-888-432-2267.

booking.source: https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/tuckahoe-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380134 (Booking Window: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 365 Day(s) in advance.') + https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/eastern/Tuckahoe/Camping-and-Cabins.aspx, read 2026-10-21

values.note: Three electric sites list 50 amp; the other 31 are 30 amp.

hookups.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/eastern/Tuckahoe/Camping-and-Cabins.aspx ('54 sites, 33 with electric hookups'; 'No water hook-ups are available, but potable water is conveniently located around each loop.') + https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/tuckahoe-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380134 (per-site details: 34 electric sites, 31 at 30 amp and 3 at 50 amp), read 2026-10-21

values.note: DNR: 54 sites, 33 with electric (the booking site lists 34 electric, in the Eagle Loop plus one in Heron, and 20 non-electric in the Heron Loop). Listed max vehicle lengths for RV sites run 25 to 64 ft, most electric sites 45-50 ft; the Heron Loop's non-electric RV sites list 25 ft.

sites.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/eastern/Tuckahoe/Camping-and-Cabins.aspx + https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/tuckahoe-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380134 (site list and per-site details: Looking For Category, Max Vehicle Length), read 2026-10-21

values.note: The camp store opens on weekends Memorial Day through Labor Day.

facilities.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/eastern/Tuckahoe/Camping-and-Cabins.aspx ('a central bathhouse with showers and toilet facilities'; 'potable water is conveniently located around each loop'; 'A dump station is available for trailer use.') + https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/eastern/tuckahoe.aspx ('The camp store and boathouse will be open on weekends Memorial Day through Labor Day.'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed on DNR's Tuckahoe pages and the booking site: 365-day window and same-day booking; 54 sites to 64 ft; 50-amp electric at three sites (30 at the rest), no water hookups; showers, potable water, dump, seasonal camp store. Fees (human-checked) match the booking table ($21.50 / $27.50, +$1 weekends). Season (manual, late March-October) matches DNR ('generally open Spring (late March) through Fall (end of October)'; reservable Mar 27-Nov 1, 2026). Pull-through not stated. Weekend/holiday minimums not stated for this park (left inherited). Phone 410-820-1668 matches. Note kept.
flags: Website: the entry's website is the booking page only; DNR's camping page is https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/eastern/Tuckahoe/Camping-and-Cabins.aspx.
